packageRules.description: Label all minor, patch, digest and pin updates (any manager, including grouped PRs) with allow-automatic-merge so Prow/Tide merges them once builds and checks are green. Major updates are left for manual review.
Major updates are never labelled allow-automatic-merge; flag them for manual review.
Group Go dependencies minor, patch and digest updates
Group the Containerfile builder image so the Go toolchain patch level arrives as one reviewable bump; it must stay at or above the go directive in go.mod.
Exempt our own traust-security packages and Konflux-built images from the dependency cooldown so releases propagate between repositories immediately.
